title: ZX Spectrum 1-bit music: Agent X (Tim Follin, 1985)
summary: A recording from real hardware of Tim Follin's multichannel 1-bit music for Agent X on the ZX Spectrum. It shows several voices coaxed out of the single-bit beeper.
why: Cited as the prime example of what clever programming can do with a 1-bit audio output.

quote.text: Tim Follin's tunes for example are basically treating the beeper like a 1-bit DAC, with amazing results.
